discovery_notes: Follow-up 4 of B005 (packets 205, 409, 454, 487). 28 standard searches, snippets only. New: June 2019 OE (two Simba, festival logo, Rhythms of the Pride Lands, two Aristocats), two extra Disney Loves Jazz LE 500 pins, Cast Refresh Lanyard pins (Belle, Lost Boy, Hippo, Fairy Godmother) from passiondlp archives. Held new: 5 Jul OE five, 14 Dec Star Wars OE six motifs. Corroboration on Jan/Aug/Oct PTN, Oct medallions, March Stitch date. No hold released. PinTrader.Club leads only.
